deploy-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT — post-deploy anomaly detected for release redwood-llm:v2.8-rc. metric: tokenizer_mismatch_rate = 12.3% (threshold 0.5%). canary-id=canary-20240304-7f. logs -> https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/canary-20240304-7f

maria: seeing elevated 502/503s at edge for text-gen routes. suspect model errors, not infra.

devon: oncall here, taking it. can you paste the canary id + any quick stack traces?

deploy-bot: canary-id: canary-20240304-7f
logs excerpt:
```
ERROR: vocab_lookup_miss at tokenizer.py:142
context: request_id=abc123, top_k_misses=3
summary: 123 mismatches / 1000 requests (12.3%)
```

lee: that "vocab_lookup_miss" looks like a tokenizer/vocab bundle mismatch — maybe the release picked a wrong tokenizer artifact.

maria: checking release manifest now. manifest shows model-package: redwood-llm@sha256:deadbeef and tokenizer_bundle: vocab-v1. production last-stable expects tokenizer_bundle: vocab-v2.

devon: if that's true, this explains garbled output and partial 5xx. any customer-facing reports?

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident escalated to SRE + Eng-Oncall. Recommended mitigation: revert routing to stable model via feature-flag or immediate rollback of the model-routing entry. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/model-rollbacks

maria: gonna flip the routing flag to stable model (rolling back traffic) — executing now. command:
```
curl -X POST \
  "https://controlplane.redwood.internal/feature-flag" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"model-routing","value":"stable-model-v2"}'
```

devon: I'll watch gateways and tracing to confirm. pls post canary metrics after flip.

maria: flipped to stable-model-v2 at 1712345690. traffic re-routed.

maria: quick metrics: tokenizer_mismatch_rate -> 0.6% (was 12.3%), 5xx rate dropped to baseline. posting short log snippet:
```
metric_update: tokenizer_mismatch_rate=0.6%
5xx_rate=0.2%
canary_health=passing
```

lee: good catch. we'll block the bad artifact in the registry (tag redwood-llm@sha256:deadbeef -> quarantine) and open a release-blocker ticket.

devon: customer impact summary for pager: ~8 customers saw degraded responses (minor), 1 sandbox customer had significant failures during test load. marking incident severity Sev2 for follow-up.

maria: :white_check_mark: mitigation complete — traffic on stable model, metrics back to normal. keeping thread open for RCA and who/what changed token bundle mapping in the deploy pipeline.

lee: next steps: 1) postmortem with timeline, 2) add CI check to validate tokenizer bundle hash vs model manifest, 3) enforce stricter artifact immutability in promotion flow.

pagerduty-bot: PD: oncall handoff scheduled at +30m for monitoring and RCA owners.

maria: thanks all — will create the incident ticket and assign RCA owners. ping me if you see any residual errors. :thumbsup:
